name: openai/gpt-oss-120b
description: gpt-oss-120b is OpenAI's largest open-weight reasoning model, released in August 2025 under the Apache 2.0 license: a 117B-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 5.1B active parameters that fits on a single 80GB GPU. OpenAI positions it for production, general-purpose and high-reasoning use, with adjustable low, medium or high reasoning, full chain-of-thought access, and native function calling, browsing, Python execution and structured outputs. It is text-only and can be self-hosted or fine-tuned.
